standard_title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement — Specification (Fourth Revision)
scope_summary: Covers physical, chemical, mechanical and dimensional requirements for cold-worked and hot-rolled/heat-treated deformed steel rebar in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600.
Consolidated statutory standard specifying physical and chemical requirements for 33, 43, and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement.

standard_title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification — Part 1: Fly-ash Based (Third Revision)
scope_summary: Covers manufacture, chemical and physical requirements of fly-ash based PPC containing 15% to 35% fly ash conforming to IS 3812 (Part 1).

standard_title: Portland Pozzolana Cement — Specification — Part 2: Calcined Clay Based (Third Revision)
scope_summary: Covers calcined clay based pozzolanic cement with 10% to 25% calcined clay pozzolana.
Specifies physical and chemical requirements of Portland Slag Cement manufactured with 25% to 70% granulated blast furnace slag.

supersedes: None (First standard for composite ternary blends in India)
scope_summary: Covers ternary blended cement comprising Portland clinker, granulated blast furnace slag (20-50%), and fly ash (15-35%).

standard_title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice (Fourth Revision)
scope_summary: Statutory structural code establishing minimum cement content, maximum water-cement ratios, and durability guidelines across exposure zones.

standard_title: Ductile Design and Detailing of Reinforced Concrete Structures Subjected to Seismic Forces — Code of Practice (First Revision)
scope_summary: Mandates use of Fe 415D, Fe 500D, or Fe 550D rebar with minimum elongation 14.5% and TS/YS ratio >= 1.08 in seismic zones III, IV, and V.

standard_title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel — Specification (Seventh Revision)
scope_summary: Specifies structural steel grades (E250, E350, E450) in sub-qualities A, BR, B0, and C for welded, riveted, or bolted civil structures.

standard_title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings — Part 1: Steel Tubes (Sixth Revision)
scope_summary: Covers welded and seamless screwed and socketed steel tubes in Light, Medium, and Heavy classes from 15mm to 150mm nominal bore.

standard_title: Chlorinated Polyvinyl Chloride (CPVC) Pipes for Potable Hot and Cold Water Distribution Supplies — Specification
scope_summary: Specifies CPVC pipes in SDR 11 and SDR 13.5 classes for potable water service up to 93 degrees Celsius.

standard_title: Ready-Mixed Concrete — Code of Practice (Second Revision)
scope_summary: Covers production, delivery, sampling, and compliance testing for batch-mixed ready-mix concrete transported in transit mixers.

standard_title: Concrete Masonry Units — Part 3: Autoclaved Cellular (Aerated) Concrete Blocks (First Revision)
scope_summary: Covers dimensional, density, and compressive strength requirements for AAC masonry blocks.

standard_title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete — Specification (Third Revision)
scope_summary: Classifies natural and manufactured aggregates (M-Sand) into grading zones (Zones I to IV) and coarse aggregate fractions.
